introduction: Pennsylvania Medical Assistance is the state’s Medicaid health-coverage program. The county assistance office reviews eligibility.
description: Pennsylvania Medical Assistance is the state’s Medicaid health-coverage program. The county assistance office reviews eligibility.

sections.who: Different categories consider income, age, disability, pregnancy and household circumstances. Specialized disability or long-term care requests can require additional evidence.
sections.get: Medical Assistance covers physical and behavioral health services. Most eligible members use HealthChoices for physical care.
sections.docs:
• Income and tax-filing details.
  • Identity, birth dates and requested status information.
  • Health insurance and any relevant resource or disability records.
sections.apply:
1. Choose an application method

    Apply at COMPASS, call 866-550-4355, or use a county assistance office or mailed form.

  2. Provide evidence

    Respond to the office’s requests for your eligibility category.

  3. Check progress

    Use Track My Benefits and read the final notice.
sections.after: After approval, follow plan-enrollment and renewal instructions. Ask your plan which providers accept the coverage.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using State Medicaid application. Current eligibility and the final decision remain with the program.

faqs: Do all categories require the same records?
No. Disability and specialized coverage can need different materials.
Does an application mean coverage started?
Check the decision and effective dates.
